يطمأن (form IVq)
# يُطْمَأَنُّ (yuṭmaʔannu) /jutˤ.ma.ʔan.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِطْمَأَنَّ (iṭmaʔanna)
# يُطْمَأَنَّ (yuṭmaʔanna) /jutˤ.ma.ʔan.na/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِطْمَأَنَّ (iṭmaʔanna)
# يُطْمَأَنِّ (yuṭmaʔanni) /jutˤ.ma.ʔan.ni/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive jussive of اِطْم
